item.title: Stealing, selling human remains in PA could be illegal under new bill
item.description: PENNSYLVANIA (WTAJ) -- A Pennsylvania Representative is looking to criminalize the theft and sale of human remains. While theft of human remains is illegal, and can often involve charges such as abuse of a corpse, burglary or intentional desecration, the sale of remains, which goes unregulated, is not explicitly banned under Pennsylvania law.
